title: Full Stack Salad
description: Adds a nutritious flower and mushroom salad!
body:
Adds a new food item, the Full Stack Salad. Intended as a lategame upgrade to golden carrots and suspicious stew, this superfood restores 6 hunger, 20 saturation (the maximum), and is stackable. The tradeoff is, you need SEVEN flowers and two mushrooms to craft one! Forage it or farm it, Full Stack Salad is the best feed you've had in Minecraft.

Note: you don't need a bowl to craft this, nor will you get one back after eating. It's just for decoration. This mod respects your inventory space!

![Crafting recipe (shapeless) for the Full Stack Salad: Red mushroom, brown mushroom, oxeye daisy, allium, poppy, orange tulip, dandelion, blue orchid, cornflower.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03422c327e059b064be32ce11665bcefcc4f47b2.png)
